# John B Joseph

> Personal site of John Bommeraveni Joseph (John B Joseph), a global leader with expertise in cybersecurity, GRC, AI security and post-quantum cryptography. He is Co-founder and Chief Product and Technology Officer of Purplecop Security, where he leads product and technology. He built the GRC Practice Lab, which has 12,000+ active users across 34 countries and was acquired by Purplecop Security in August 2026. He publishes the GRC Made Simple Daily newsletter.

This file lists the pages on this site and the public records behind it.

## This site

- [Home](https://johnbjoseph-cybersec.github.io/): profile, open-source contributions, projects, newsletter and speaking
- [Achievements](https://johnbjoseph-cybersec.github.io/#achievements): merged and accepted open-source work by organisation, the University of Texas at Austin Security Hall of Fame recognition, and GitHub achievement badges, each linked to its public record
- [Site data](https://johnbjoseph-cybersec.github.io/data/site.json): the figures the home page shows, as JSON

- [alirezarezvani/claude-skills #1121](https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills/pull/1121): docs(eu-ai-act-specialist): correct Article 43(1) conformity route for biometrics (merged 2026-11-10)
- [shorlist/shorlist #2](https://github.com/shorlist/shorlist/pull/2): PEM rows for PKCS #8, SPKI and certificates; ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 key files (SL-3637 to SL-3647) (merged 2026-11-10)
- [h4ckf0r0day/obscura #1513](https://github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura/pull/1513): docs: list the full SSRF deny-set under OBSCURA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK (merged 2026-11-11)
- [UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai #6545](https://github.com/UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai/pull/6545): docs: add inspect-oscal to the extensions listing (merged 2026-11-13)
- [Balanov/uncut #8](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/pull/8): fix(tools): probe the process group before cancelling run_command (merged 2026-11-14)
